chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from one of his companions, from Zur'at ibn Muhammad, from Sama'ah who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man who entered a slave girl to enjoy her, then forgot to stipulate (the term and dowry) until he had intercourse with her. Would the punishment of the adulterer be obligatory upon him? He (peace be upon him) said: 'No, but he enjoys her after the marriage, and he seeks forgiveness from Allah for what he did.'

key_terms.حَدُّ الزَّانِي: the legal punishment of the adulterer
key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعُ: to enjoy (in the context of temporary marriage)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one forgets to stipulate the term and dowry in Mut'ah before intercourse?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that the omission of stipulating the duration and dowry in temporary marriage (Mut'ah) does not invalidate the contract or incur the Hadd for adultery, distinguishing it from permanent marriage requirements. The Imam prescribes seeking forgiveness (Istighfar) for the procedural oversight, highlighting the flexibility of Mut'ah jurisprudence in Shia law. This ruling underscores the principle that the core validity of Mut'ah rests on the mutual consent and the act of marriage itself, rather than strict adherence to all formalities prior to consummation.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from one of his companions, from Zur’at Bin Muhammad, from Sama’at who said,

‘I asked himasws about a man slept with a slave girl by way of Mut’a with her, then forgets that he should be stipulating (Mahr and term) until he has slept with her. Would it Obligate the legal punishment (Hadd) of the adulterer upon him?’ Heasws said: ‘No, but he enjoyed with her after the marriage, and he should seek Forgiveness of Allahazwj from what he has done’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from certain persons of his people from Zur’ah ibn Muhammad from Sanaa ‘ah who has said the following: “

I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘A man goes to bed with a girl (slave-girl) in the manner of al-Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage) and forgets to mention the conditions until he has gone to bed with her; if he must be punished as a fornicator. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, but he can take advantage after forming marriage and ask Allah to forgive him because of what he has done.’”
